description: In 1946 New York, Peggy Carter secretly helps Howard Stark clear his name and recover stolen inventions while the SSR hunts him as a traitor. With Edwin Jarvis as her covert partner, she uncovers Leviathan, sleeper agent Dottie Underwood and psychiatrist Johann Fennhoff, whose revenge plot centers on Stark’s wartime chemical weapon Midnight Oil.

s01e01.description: In 1946 New York, Peggy Carter secretly helps the fugitive Howard Stark clear his name after his stolen inventions begin reaching dangerous buyers.

s01e02.description: Peggy and Jarvis hunt the remaining nitramene weapons and the mysterious Leviathan agent carrying them while the SSR closes in on the same trail.

s01e03.description: Peggy and Jarvis trace Stark’s stolen technology to the docks, but the SSR’s investigation threatens to expose Peggy’s covert work.

s01e04.description: Howard Stark secretly returns to New York and asks Peggy to retrieve a dangerous device, only for her to discover he has concealed its real purpose.

s01e05.description: Peggy joins the Howling Commandos on a mission into a Soviet facility, where the team discovers the brutal program behind Leviathan’s sleeper agents.

s01e06.description: With the SSR now suspecting Peggy of betrayal, she and Jarvis race to identify Leviathan’s female operative before her colleagues arrest her.

s01e07.description: Held for interrogation by the SSR, Peggy tries to convince her colleagues that Dr. Ivchenko is a Leviathan agent while he quietly turns the agency against itself.

s01e08.description: Peggy and the SSR race to stop Johann Fennhoff and Dottie Underwood from using Stark’s Midnight Oil to turn New York into a mass killing ground.
